sn55.12:1.7: Unsurprisingly for a practice with such a high mortality rate, the _udayagāmini_ is not attested in Brahmanical texts. It seems to be a misunderstanding of the _udayanīya_, which is a concluding rite; after bathing (_avabhṛtha_) the sacrificer emerges from the water (_udayanīya_). Bhāradvāja-śrauta-sūtra 14.25.13 says that after the _udayanīya_, those performing the sacrifice should move away towards the east, north, or according to some, the north-east.
